messages:
Jordan (Sales): Handoff for NimbusHealth — signed last week, Dedicated trial starts Mon. Quick summary: SSO via Okta not configured, customer requested private deployment inside their VPC, expected steady traffic ~10k req/day, test bench from sales shows p50 ~450ms (their infra), they flagged potential egress/cost concerns and asked about HIPAA addendum. Renewal window is 12 months; price sensitivity noted. Asks: CS to own onboarding runbook + weekly enablement, SE to validate SSO & perf baseline, Support to prep network/firewall guidance. I uploaded sales notes: https://1password.example/sales/nimbus-notes and shared test creds via 1Password. Can CS/SE/Support sync Wed 10am PT?

Maria (CS): Got it — I'll take onboarding lead. Wed 10am PT works for a quick kickoff. Jordan, can you confirm primary customer contacts + the Okta SAML metadata? Also adding Priya and Lee to the thread. I'll create the onboarding runbook template and share.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Priya here — I'll scope the SSO flow and run a perf baseline against their sample payloads. Jordan, can you paste their typical request shape (avg tokens/sequence length) or ask them to run our quick bench script and share output? Example bench we ask them to run: ```curl -X POST https://bench.redwood.internal/run -d '{"model":"gpt-large","seq":512,"requests":100}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

Lee (Support): Lee — I'll prep the private deploy networking checklist and firewall/IP allowlist. If they're doing a VPC peering or private link, we'll need CIDR + egress requirements. Tagging infra-oncall.

deploy-bot: New ticket created CS-4821 for NimbusHealth onboarding — https://tickets.redwood/cs/4821 (assigned to Maria).

Maria (CS): Owners: Jordan = sales liaison, Maria = onboarding lead (CS-4821), Priya = SE for SSO & perf, Lee = support/ops for private deploy. Next steps I put on the ticket: 1) Jordan share Okta SAML metadata + primary contacts; 2) Priya to run perf baseline and recommend batch/quant settings; 3) Lee to publish firewall IPs and network checklist; 4) Maria to schedule weekly enablement + capture feedback. I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 10am PT now.

Jordan (Sales): Shared Okta metadata and 1Password link to test creds. Also flagged: customer requires HIPAA addendum before private deploy. Renewal risk: medium long-term if initial infra cost looks high — they asked for an estimate.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Noted HIPAA constraint. I'll include encryption/KMS notes in the runbook. Running perf baseline now, will post results and recommended config (quant profile, batch size) by EOD Thu.

Lee (Support): Firewall IPs for private peering & egress: 34.210.12.5, 34.210.12.6, ports 443 & 2222 for admin. I'll attach the preflight checklist to CS-4821.

Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll loop in Legal for HIPAA addendum (cc Legal (Contracts)). I'll also prepare a short enablement deck for the customer with expected SLOs and cost controls to reduce churn risk. Report back after Wednesday sync. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Sales): Perfect, thanks everyone. Ping me if you need the contact who owns procurement — they're sensitive to sticker shock so include a clear cost breakdown in the deck.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Will include per-route cost estimates and a recommended fallback model for graceful degradation.

Lee (Support): Ready to assist during private deploy window.

Maria (CS): Closing loop — invite sent, ticket updated, owners assigned. I'll capture customer feedback during onboarding and surface any quality regressions to product.

Jordan (Sales): Thanks all.

Priya (Solutions Eng): +1

Lee (Support): +1
